Lecture slides for CS 4140 — Software Engineering.

## Databases

- [One Commit Point](nosql-slides/index.qmd) — one lecture on why NoSQL exists:
  the ACID transaction assumes a single commit point, a single commit point does
  not survive multiple writers across machines, and every system in the lecture
  is a position on where that point goes and who pays for it.
